programmes.title: Fierce Cop
programmes.description: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programmes.title: Fight Back to School III
programmes.description: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programmes.title: Shaolin
programmes.description: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programmes.title: Hero
programmes.description: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programmes.title: Gorgeous
programmes.description: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programmes.title: Cruel War
programmes.description: Scientist Yan Xin develops super rubber seeds and travels to a remote, lawless, drug-ridden region to cultivate them. Security captain Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife and her crew, but they are besieged by a cartel on arrival. Lin Xiang and his men navigate hostile forces, vowing to take their enemies down with them.

programmes.title: The Great Magician
programmes.description: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programmes.title: Iceman
programmes.description: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programmes.title: Mr. Possessed
programmes.description: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programmes.title: Ghost Wedding
programmes.description: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programmes.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programmes.description: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programmes.title: Infernal Affairs II
programmes.description: In this prequel, the secrets of “Infernal Affairs” are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sam's wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programmes.title: Never Leave
programmes.description: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programmes.title: Shark Busters
programmes.description: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. programmes.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Bad Luck Moon Rising
programmes.description: "Phil and Guy try to disprove the Croods' belief that leaving offerings to the fire moon will prevent bad luck. But when their efforts seem to cause a series of mishaps, they'll have to retrieve the horn of a dangerous ramaconda to turn                        their luck around."

programmes.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Beardfoot
programmes.description: Upset that he can't grow a beard, Grug resorts to some unorthodox hair growth methods. But when Phil's experimental hair formula makes fur grow all over Grug's body, he flees to the woods to avoid the other farm residents' attempts to shave him.

programmes.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Meltdown
programmes.description: The team is reunited, but now they must race against the clock to stop Dann from setting off an explosion that will melt the polar ice caps and send the world into a new Ice Age.

programmes.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Hollywood Beginning
programmes.description: Three months after their battle in the arctic, the team is back in L.A. with one major change: they’ve been fired as Spy Racers! Most of the team is able to easily readjust to civilian life: Frostee is trying to get his license and Layla is a professional stunt driver in the biggest movie franchise in the world. But Tony can’t rest; his gut is telling him that Dann is still out there and is plotting to destroy L.A. and he’ll stop at nothing to prove it.

programmes.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Dann Hunt
programmes.description: Tony was right; Dann is back and she’s been spotted all around Los Angeles! The Spy Racers get back together on an unofficial mission to bring her down! Meanwhile, Ms. Nowhere, Palindrome and Roscoe run their out bounty hunter operation.

programmes.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Stryke Out
programmes.description: Hiccup and Toothless are captured and must find a way to escape the Dragon Fighting arena and survive an attack from the fearsome Triple Stryke dragon.

programmes.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Tone Death
programmes.description: After the Riders save a Deathsong egg from the Dragon Hunters, they must take it back to Melody Island when the hatched baby won't stop crying.

programmes.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Between A Rock And A Hard Place
programmes.description: When Hiccup and the Riders discover that Viggo is using two captured Catastrophic Quakens to build a dragon prison, they must help the dragons escape.
programmes.episode_title: Between A Rock And A Hard Place

programmes.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock
programmes.description: With fun in short supply, Harold and George persuade Krupp to dump the campers in the middle of the forest so they can learn to rough it.
programmes.episode_title: Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock

programmes.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist
programmes.description: The pressure's on Harold and George to tell the scariest campfire story ever. Perhaps their tale of an ill-fated frontier dentist will do the trick.
programmes.episode_title: Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist

programmes.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato
programmes.description: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.
programmes.episode_title: Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato

programmes.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Trading Up
programmes.description: Boss takes an overdue vacation day, and ends up teaching Tabitha the value of "trading up" valueless objects into something she actually wants, an electric scooter. However, a 5%er baby is in trouble and BB's field team has "got it under control"… or do they? Boss tries to juggle his Tabitha lessons with sneaking peeks at the mission in progress

programmes.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - War of the Cheeks
programmes.description: Boss searches for evidence that Tabitha's best friend is an Uncuddleable, but is sidetracked by a Templeton Family tradition: "The War of the Cheeks", a Go Fish tournament where the winner gets to make family rules for a whole day. When Yvette joins in, Boss has to keep her from winning, out of fear that an evil babysitter will make family rules that overturn the Templeton household.

programmes.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Techy Tykes
programmes.description: Trying to win Tabitha's loyalty for Baby Corp, Boss and Tina invite her to Techy Tykes, a technology convention at their office. But when the top-secret UBO goes missing, the outsiders Tabitha and Tim (who's tagged along to relive his glory days) immediately become the number one suspects.

programmes.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Doubtful Drought
programmes.description: When Grayson has the only working well during an unexpected heat wave, Lucky has to find an alternate source of water

programmes.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Arabian Nightmares
programmes.description: When Al goes out of town, he puts the PALs in charge of the ramada, but they get more than they bargained for when three trouble-making horses escape

programmes.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Fearless Fillies
programmes.description: When the PALs and Snips get caught in a sandstorm, the girls must keep Snips calm and safe

programmes.title: All Hail King Julien: Exiled S3 - For Whom The Bell Gods Toll
programmes.description: King Julien accidentally blows himself up and must stand trial to be awarded a second chance; Mort battles Morticus Khan for control of the Mort army
programmes.episode_title: For Whom The Bell Gods Toll

programmes.title: All Hail King Julien: Exiled S3 - Out Of The Foosa Pen And Into The Fire
programmes.description: King Julien and his army plan to trap Koto; Mort must get his army to the lemur kingdom to help King Julien; Clover agrees to marry Koto
programmes.episode_title: Out Of The Foosa Pen And Into The Fire

programmes.title: All Hail King Julien: Exiled S3 - The Day After Yesterday
programmes.description: King Julien's attempts to destroy Koto were unsuccessful but the allies he's formed all come to help out, and Koto's wedding turns into all-out battle

programmes.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S1 - Something's Glotta Give / Afternoon Contrite
programmes.description: Lucretia plays cupid to try to bring Lotta and Gerald together. / When Lotta thinks she broke up the Bloogey Boys, she sets out to reunite them.

programmes.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S1 - Can't Harvey Wait / Bring It Prawn
programmes.description: Lucretia recounts three amazing tales of Harvey Girls fan fiction. / Audrey must partner with Zoe in a shrimp-sponsored sibling beauty pageant.
programmes.episode_title: Can't Harvey Wait / Bring It Prawn

programmes.title: Dinotrux S3 - Shredadon
programmes.description: While collecting scrap in a canyon, the Trux and Tools come face-to-face with a frightful Shredadon -- but may need its help to leave its lair.

programmes.title: Dinotrux S3 - Lil' Dread
programmes.description: Ton-Ton befriends a baby Dreadtrux but learns the hard way that even "Lil' Dread" can cause major chaos in the renegade base.

programmes.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Hidden
programmes.description: Puss stumbles upon the legendary hidden city of San Lorenzo, and soon finds himself forced to protect it from thieves.

programmes.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S1 - Sphinx
programmes.description: Puss accidentally gives the orphans a magic substance that will ultimately make them explode. The only cure is guarded by a Sphinx who challenges Puss with riddles - and contrary to his own belief, Puss is not good at riddles.

programmes.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Frank and Beans with Chili / Little Hound on the Prairie
programmes.description: Beans is nervous that Frank is starting to make a new best friend, so Beans enlists Tag to help him win Frank back. \ Grandpaw and Grandmaw tell Tag the story of the early days of Pawston. Tag’s ancestor, Tagatha, built a steam-engine and turned Pawston from a one-house town into a thriving community.
programmes.episode_title: Frank and Beans with Chili / Little Hound on the Prairie

programmes.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Revenge Of The Creature Catcher / Slugby
programmes.description: Revenge of the Creature Catcher Casper, Mantha and Ra accidentally lead Jimmy's father to the underworld.Slugby. To prove that the teachers haven't gone soft, Alder and Dash stage a Slugby match.
programmes.episode_title: Revenge Of The Creature Catcher / Slugby

programmes.description: You Oughta Be in Pictures When Mantha sees a Deedstown mob attacking a group of fellow zombies, she's determined to lead them in a counterattack. Crypt Critters Mantha comes down with an embarrassing case of crypt critters, but refuses to go to the nurse.
programmes.episode_title: You Oughta Be In Pictures / Crypt Critters

programmes.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - The Amazing Donna / Bye, Bye Boardie
programmes.description: When Donna decides to show off her not-so-flashy skills as a magician at the Community Center talent show, the Zenkos must do everything they can to save her act from becoming an embarrassing disaster. / After Sam’s favorite skateboard accidentally gets put in with donations Mr. Tanaka is collecting for a fundraiser, the team is led on a merry chase as the skateboard passes from one Harmony Harbor denizen to another.
programmes.episode_title: The Amazing Donna / Bye, Bye Boardie

programmes.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Lula's Last Stand / Triple Trouble
programmes.description: Little Lula has set up a lemonade stand, but she’s not getting any business. The Zenkos swing into action to send customers her way. / When Donna, Fawna and Rona have a spat, the triplets’ longstanding annual tradition of viewing a comet together is in jeopardy. Now it’s up to Team Zenko to get the three feuding sisters back together again before the comet streaks by.

programmes.title: Olivia S2 - Magnificent Magnet Girl
programmes.description: Olivia manages to gather up enough coins to get her Dad a rare comic book for Father’s Day, but she’s too late – it’s already been sold. Instead of despairing, Olivia has a brilliant idea: she and her friends will act out the thrilling adventures of Magnet Girl themselves – much to Dad’s delight!

programmes.title: Olivia S2 - Puppy Love
programmes.description: When Perry takes a liking to a dog that follows Olivia home, Olivia decides they should get married. Elaborate wedding plans ensue, but at the last minute, the “bride” runs away! To find her, Olivia will need a little from Perry, and from the dog’s surprise owner – Daisy!

programmes.title: Olivia S2 - Teacher of the Year
programmes.description: Mrs. Hogenmuller is being evaluated for a “Teacher of the Year” award, and Olivia is determined to make sure everything goes smoothly. But despite her best efforts, chaos ensues. Luckily, she has a plan to show Mrs. H. that she doesn’t need an award to be teacher of the year in the eyes of her students!

programmes.title: Olivia S2 - Little Big House
programmes.description: When Dad’s elaborate scale house model is destroyed, Olivia takes it upon herself to build another one before Dad returns home with his important client. What’s more, her version will be better, redder, and bigger – so big that she and Ian have to build it in the backyard!

programmes.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - Cappy's Mail Order Eyes / Pumpkin Pal
programmes.description: Cappy’s Mail Order Eyes ‐ Casper and his friends order some new eyes for Cappy’s birthday present. The little monsters suddenly realise that they’ve ordered Sea Monkey eyes by mistake! Casper has to get Cappy AND the eyes back before Cappy loses his marbles completely. programmes.title: MEGA Fights Paul Williams vs. Kermit Cintron
programmes.description: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features former champions Paul 'The Punisher' Williams (38-1, 27 KOs) and 'El Asesino' Kermit Cintron (32-2, 28 KOs) in a middleweight battle. The fight took place at the Home Depot Center in Carson, California, USA, on May 8, 2010. This bout is noted for a bizarre injury that saw the fight stopped in the fourth round

programmes.title: BWF Martial Arts - Men's Forms Championships
programmes.description: This episode features highlights from the Men's Forms Championships as well as Girl's Weapons, Synchronized Team Forms and Boy's and Girl's Traditional Weapons.

programmes.title: KNOCKOUTS! Danny Garcia vs. Erik Morales
programmes.description: The main event in this episode is Danny Garcia looking to win the WBC super lightweight championship when he squares off with Erik Morales, but Garcia must battle back after suffering a nose injury early on. Also on the card, former world champions Hector Camacho and Adonis Stevenson.

programmes.title: FS Grand Sumo - Osaka, Japan: Show 1
programmes.description: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Show 1 featuring Goeido, Shodai, Takayasu and Ichinojo from the Haru basho, 2018.

programmes.title: Prison Fighters
programmes.description: This series follows former Muay Thai champion Noy Khaopan and American Cody Moberly, two inmates in a Thailand prison, who after seven years are given the chance to fight for their release. By joining a controversial government modern day Prison Fight program, murderers and felons are given the chance to fight for their freedom, and possible redemption, through the ancient tradition of Muay Thai matches. Episode 4 of 4.

programmes.title: Judo for the World - Ekaterinburg Grand Slam
programmes.description: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best of the Judo Grand Slam from Ekaterinburg, speak with number 1 ranked fighter Khasan Khalmurzaev about his return to Judo, and show Soichi Hashimoto's success using his signature throw.
